exercises.problemHtml:
PRACTICAL EXAMINATION

FER202 · SPRING 2026 Block 5 PE — Company Management (same paper as the Exam Room's PE1). Duration: 85 minutes.

Technical Requirement: json-server serves database.json at http://localhost:9999 (npx json-server --watch database.json --port 9999); the React app runs at http://localhost:3000. 0 points if JSON Server / the app does not run or the URL is incorrect.

Question 1 (2 points) — Department List

  • Component routing at http://localhost:3000. Fetch data from the API.
  • Display the departments in a table: DepName | Manager | Employees.
  • Display the manager's full name (from employees via managerId).
  • Provide a View button to show the employees of that department (filter employees by depId) — Question 2.

Question 2 (4 points) — Employee & Project Information

  • Render the employee list of the chosen department with an Accordion (header #<no.> - <fullname>; add - Manager when supervisorId === null).
  • For each employee show EmployeeId, Gender, BirthDate and a View Dependents button.
  • Projects worked on: WorkId | Project Name | Work Hours | Salary, where hourly = empSalary / 176 and salary = hourly × workHours (decimals truncated, VN dot separators).
  • Show the total: Projects Salary: XXX VND (IT · Binh Tran: 4.261.363 + 2.840.909 = 7.102.272 VND).

Question 3 (4 points) — Dependents Management

  • View Dependents ⇒ No. | Name | Birthdate | Relationship; none ⇒ No dependents.
  • Add form: Fullname, Birthdate, Relationship (first option --- Type of relationship ---, then Wife, Son, Daughter, Father, Mother, Father in law, Mother in law).
  • Validation (show a list of errors): "Fullname is required", "Birthdate is required", "Birthdate must be before today", "Please choose a relationship".
  • On success add the dependent to the employee, send PUT http://localhost:9999/employees/:id and update the UI immediately.

Code Lab — auto-grader notes (not part of the paper)

The grader opens the page at /, clicks View of a department, then View Dependents of an employee. Keep every Accordion item in the DOM (react-bootstrap does by default) so the buttons of collapsed items can still be clicked.

Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#department-table · .department-row · #dep-row-<id> · .manager-name · .view-btnQ1 — the table, one row per department (id = dep-row- + id), the manager cell, the View button
#employee-accordion · .employee-item · #emp-item-<id> · .employee-headerQ2 — the Accordion, one item per employee (id = emp-item- + employee id), its header
.work-row · .work-salary · .projects-salary · .view-dependentsinside an item: one row per work, its salary cell, the "Projects Salary" line, the View Dependents button
#dependents · .dependent-row · .no-dependentsQ3 — the dependents panel, one row per dependent, the "No dependents" text
#dep-fullname · #dep-birthdate · #dep-relationship · #dep-addthe Add form (birthdate is input type="date")

Auto-grader rubric (10 points, Run = sample checks · Submit = full rubric incl. hidden)

#Rubric lineMarks
1Q1 · Department list + manager name + View2
2Q2 · Employee Accordion (fields, Manager label)1.5
3Q2 · Projects, salary per project, Projects Salary total2.5
4Q3 · Dependents list / No dependents1.5
5Q3 · Validation messages1.5
6Q3 · Add dependent: PUT + UI updates immediately1

Requirements

  • Start the mock API as in the exam: npx json-server --watch database.json --port 9999; the app at http://localhost:3000.
  • The starter is a bare CRA entry: add Bootstrap CSS and the three parts yourself.
  • Press Run for the sample checks, Submit for the full rubric (hidden checks included). Time yourself: 85 minutes.

Câu 1 (2 điểm) — Danh sách phòng ban

  • Route http://localhost:3000; lấy dữ liệu từ API; bảng DepName | Manager | Employees.
  • Tên trưởng phòng tra từ employees theo managerId.
  • Nút View hiện nhân viên của phòng (lọc theo depId) — Câu 2.

Câu 2 (4 điểm) — Nhân viên & dự án

  • Danh sách nhân viên của phòng bằng Accordion (tiêu đề #<stt> - <fullname>, thêm - Manager khi supervisorId === null).
  • Mỗi người: EmployeeId, Gender, BirthDate, nút View Dependents.
  • Bảng dự án: WorkId | Project Name | Work Hours | Salary; lương giờ = empSalary / 176, lương = lương giờ × workHours (bỏ phần lẻ, dấu chấm kiểu Việt).
  • Tổng: Projects Salary: XXX VND (Binh Tran: 4.261.363 + 2.840.909 = 7.102.272 VND).

Câu 3 (4 điểm) — Người phụ thuộc

  • Bấm View Dependents ⇒ bảng No. | Name | Birthdate | Relationship; không có ⇒ No dependents.
  • Form thêm: Fullname, Birthdate, Relationship (lựa chọn đầu --- Type of relationship ---, rồi Wife, Son, Daughter, Father, Mother, Father in law, Mother in law).
  • Kiểm hợp lệ (hiện danh sách lỗi): "Fullname is required", "Birthdate is required", "Birthdate must be before today", "Please choose a relationship".
  • Hợp lệ ⇒ thêm vào employee, gửi PUT http://localhost:9999/employees/:id, giao diện cập nhật ngay.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The page keeps the employees and the two selections (department, employee) in the parent. Question 1 joins departments with employees for the manager name; Question 2 filters by depId, joins works with projects and computes each salary with Math.floor(empSalary / 176 × hours) before summing. Question 3 edits the embedded dependents array: validate, build the new employee object, PUT it, and replace it in the parent state so every part re-renders.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Trang giữ danh sách nhân viên và hai lựa chọn (phòng, nhân viên) ở component cha. Câu 1 nối departments với employees để lấy tên trưởng phòng; Câu 2 lọc theo depId, nối works với projects và tính từng khoản lương bằng Math.floor(empSalary / 176 × giờ) rồi mới cộng. Câu 3 sửa mảng dependents lồng: kiểm hợp lệ, dựng object nhân viên mới, PUT, rồi thay vào state cha để mọi phần vẽ lại.

mistakesJson.loi: Hiện managerId (1, 2, 7) thay vì tên trưởng phòng.
Làm tròn (Math.round) thay vì bỏ phần lẻ, hoặc cộng rồi mới làm tròn ⇒ lệch 1 VND so với mẫu.
Dùng toLocaleString() không tham số ⇒ dấu phẩy thay vì dấu chấm.
Gửi POST /dependents (không có collection đó) thay vì PUT cả employee.
Không truyền key ⇒ đổi nhân viên mà form/lỗi của người trước vẫn còn.
So ngày bằng new Date("2015-05-05") (UTC) với new Date() ⇒ lệch múi giờ; so chuỗi YYYY-MM-DD địa phương.
